description: The paginate() helper in paging.py is used by the reporting service to slice records into pages. Users report that every page is missing its final record: page 1 of 10 items with per_page=3 returns only 2 items. Fix paginate() so that a full page contains per_page items, a partial final page returns the remainder, and out-of-range pages return an empty list. Keep the existing validation that page and per_page must be >= 1.
expected_behavior: paginate(range(10), 1, 3) == [0, 1, 2]; paginate(range(10), 4, 3) == [9]; paginate(range(10), 9, 3) == []. Validation errors unchanged.
notes: Synthetic defect seeded for the VerifyLoop benchmark. Not a production incident.
title: Pagination drops the last item of every page
